claim_atoms.source_fact: GameStatus is the four-value union start, playing, victory, defeat.
claim_atoms.interpretation: These are source-defined core status values; no live execution is claimed.

claim_atoms.source_fact: Maze creation uses an 11-column by 15-row configuration, walls on the outer boundary and even/even interior coordinates, and opens the left entrance at row 1 and right exit at row rows-2.
claim_atoms.interpretation: This is deterministic maze construction logic; it does not prove a rendered or navigable live maze.

claim_atoms.source_fact: State creation rejects an empty sentence list, defaults difficulty to normal and goblin type to scout, initializes status to start, and places the player at tileSize/2, tileSize*1.5 moving right.
claim_atoms.interpretation: Initialization behavior only; it does not prove the start control was activated.

claim_atoms.source_fact: The configured gameplay arena is 390 by 700 pixels with 32-pixel tiles, 28-pixel player and goblin sizes, player speed 3, heroic aura duration 6000 ms, and chase range 100.
claim_atoms.interpretation: These are configuration literals and not measurements of a running viewport.

claim_atoms.source_fact: The tick function derives desired direction from dx/dy, attempts a snapped turn when within 0.45 tileSize, and otherwise continues the prior direction when movement remains possible.
claim_atoms.interpretation: This source envelope describes directional movement logic, not successful keyboard, pointer, touch, or browser movement.

claim_atoms.source_fact: canMove tests all four corners of a size-adjusted player or goblin rectangle through isWall, and out-of-maze coordinates are walls.
claim_atoms.interpretation: The implementation defines collision rejection against maze walls; no runtime collision result is claimed.

claim_atoms.source_fact: A newly collected orb is correct only when its orderIndex equals targetIndex; correct collection increments correctAnswers, appends the word, and increments targetIndex.
claim_atoms.interpretation: The source defines ordered word collection; it does not prove a learner completed it.

claim_atoms.source_fact: When the final word orb in a sentence is collected in order, the source enables heroic aura, marks goblins fleeing, advances to the next sentence modulo allSentences, respawns word orbs, clears collectedWords, and resets targetIndex.
claim_atoms.interpretation: This is a source-defined playing-to-playing transition; browser transition and completion are unknown.

claim_atoms.source_fact: A wrong orb increments wrongAnswers, removes one life, sets invulnerabilityDuration, and attempts to reposition the orb at an available floor position.
claim_atoms.interpretation: The wrong-order penalty is source-defined; no live defeat or recovery is claimed.

claim_atoms.source_fact: Goblin movement selects fleeing directions away from the player, chases for non-scout types within chaseRange, otherwise patrols with a non-reverse preference, and collision costs a life unless heroic aura marks the goblin eaten.
claim_atoms.interpretation: This is source-defined hazard and aura logic; it does not prove encounters or goblin defeat in a browser.

claim_atoms.source_fact: The page fetches sentence data from /api/v1/games/labyrinth-goblin-king/sentences with locale and posts completion data to /api/v1/games/labyrinth-goblin-king/complete.
claim_atoms.interpretation: These are exact client route references; they do not establish server reachability, persistence, or API correctness.

claim_atoms.source_fact: The component computes scale as the minimum of container width/GAME_WIDTH and height/GAME_HEIGHT.
claim_atoms.interpretation: Responsive source logic is present; compact/wide live composition remains unverified without browser evidence.

negative_fixtures.assertion: The source proves the maze can be completed by a learner in a browser.
negative_fixtures.reason: Source envelopes establish logic only; no live interaction or completion observation exists.

negative_fixtures.assertion: The route citation proves POST persistence and API correctness.
negative_fixtures.reason: A client fetch call is not server execution, persistence, or correctness evidence.

negative_fixtures.assertion: The 390x700 constants prove compact and wide responsive behavior.
negative_fixtures.reason: Configuration and CSS/source scaling do not replace live compact/wide browser evidence.

negative_fixtures.assertion: The title or goblin asset names prove a Goblin King boss encounter and asset usage.
negative_fixtures.reason: Title, catalog, or file presence cannot establish a mechanic or concrete runtime asset use.
